title: stroke-width - SVG - Tailwind CSS
content_text:
SVG stroke-width Utilities for styling the stroke width of SVG elements. Class Styles stroke- stroke-width: ; stroke-(length:) stroke-width: var(); stroke-[] stroke-width: ; EXAMPLES Basic example Use stroke- utilities like stroke-1 and stroke-2 to set the stroke width of an SVG: This can be useful for styling icon sets like Heroicons. Using a custom value Use the stroke-[] syntax to set the stroke width based on a completely custom value:
For CSS variables, you can also use the stroke-(length:) syntax:
This is just a shorthand for stroke-[length:var()] that adds the var() function for you automatically. Responsive design Prefix a stroke-width utility with a breakpoint variant like md: to only apply the utility at medium screen sizes and above:
